lede: Pittsburgh Steelers carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#22 in EPA per play), while Cleveland Browns owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#7 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Cleveland Browns -0.8 with a fair total of 37.4 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Pittsburgh Steelers pass offence vs Cleveland Browns pass defence, which sits −0.235 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
